standard: Doughty T57000 / T57200 half coupler & hook clamp (Ø48-51 barrel)
description: Stage-rigging half coupler / hook clamp (Doughty T57000/T57200 class) as an eight-body assembly: the one-piece lobed-pentagon body with its deep U-jaw around the standard Ø48-51 barrel, the closure strap that runs from a pinned hinge tongue over the barrel into a flat cantilevered tab, the two ISO 8752 slotted spring pins, the swing closing bolt with ring thread, and the nut stack the sheet draws on it — ISO 7089 washer, ISO 4032 hexagon nut, DIN 315-style wing nut, the last two threaded onto the bolt's ring grid. All mates are contact-or-clearance; the hook-clamp variant replaces the tang eye with the protruding M12 stud.
source: Doughty T57000/T57010/T58080/T58100/T57200 datasheets (bore, width, eye, base drop, stud), front view measured against its own 107/55/19/16 dimensions at 3.6075 px/mm; cross-checked vs Riggatec/Global Truss/Kupo; ISO 8752 / ISO 7089 / ISO 4032 / DIN 315 for the hardware; wall, tab and lobe proportions
